name: Sallie Mae (private student loans)
notes: Researched from public salliemae.com pages only (no sign-in). Sign-in is by username (the FAQ's forgot-username flow retrieves it with SSN or Customer ID and birthdate). Auto Debit drafts a bank account and earns a 0.25% interest rate reduction; card payments are not described on the public ways-to-pay page, so payments are modelled as bank-only. Late fee applies when the Current Amount Due is unpaid 15 days after the due date; the fee amount is not published, so it is not modelled. No guest (unauthenticated) payment is documented. Hardship options: Loan Modification, Payment Extension, Reduced Payment Plan. Closing a loan is not a customer action (paid off loans close), so cancel service stays not applicable.

help.title: Auto Debit
paragraphs: Auto Debit takes your monthly student loan payment automatically from the bank account you authorize, so you never miss a due date.

Signing up for Auto Debit qualifies you for a 0.25% interest rate reduction. You can have the Current Amount Due drafted or choose to pay more each month; there is no penalty for paying extra or early.
steps: Choose the bank account and the amount to draft.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Payments made online or in the app by 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time count for that day; they show in your payment history within a few business days.

You can also pay through the automated phone line at 800-472-5543, through your bank's bill pay, or by mailing a check or money order with your 16-digit Loan Group Number at least 10 days before the due date. Borrowers mail payments to P.O. Box 8459, Philadelphia PA 19101-8459; cosigners use P.O. Box 8377.

help.title: Late fees
paragraphs: A late fee is charged if your Current Amount Due is not paid within 15 days after the due date. A returned payment fee applies when a check or bank payment does not clear.
Late payments can also cost you borrower benefits and be reported to the credit bureaus.

help.title: Payment Difficulties
paragraphs: If you are behind or struggling to pay, Sallie Mae may review you for one of three programs: a Loan Modification that lowers your monthly payment, a Payment Extension that brings you current through three consecutive payments, or a Reduced Payment Plan with six months of interest-only payments. Eligibility is reviewed case by case.
Call 800-472-5543 or chat with Sallie Mae to talk about your options.

help.title: Forgot your username or password
paragraphs: On the log in page, choose the forgot username link and enter your Social Security number or Customer ID with your date of birth to get your username back.
To reset a password, choose Forgot your password? on the log in page and follow the prompts. If you never set up security questions, chat with Sallie Mae or call for help.
